title: Rock of Desolation
wikitext:
'''The Rock of Desolation''' is a piece of the shattered world of [[Draenor]], connected to the [[Tower of Karazhan]] through the [[Netherspace]]. From here, the [[nathrezim]] [[Mephistroth]] sought to turn Karazhan into a point of entry to Azeroth to begin an invasion anew. Corrupted members of the [[draenei]] [[Tribe of Sanv]], under [[Sanv Tas'dal]], established the [[Sanv Tribe Village]] upon the rock.
